full_judgment: "Under section 76 of this Act it lies at the disposal of the Government who may either manage it khas or make settlement thereof in accordance with rules to be made by them. In the absence of any such rules, the Government must follow certain fixed standards; principles or guidelines applicable to all persons seeking settlement and shall not act arbitrarily or in discriminatory manner".
